whyItMatters: random.randint is predictable in python, so security values drawn from it can be guessed by an attacker.
actions: Replace random.randint with secrets.token_bytes / secrets.choice for tokens, nonces, salts, and secrets.
For remaining statistical uses, add a comment stating predictability is acceptable.
Re-run the scan and confirm every security draw uses the cryptographic generator.
verification: Rescan shows no random.randint feeding security values, and token prediction tests fail.
